verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API for my.anydesk account data and an official CLI, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows API version identifiers, a versioning scheme, or a published deprecation policy. The only 'v1' strings appear in help-center documentation paths (e.g., /v1/docs, llms.txt '## v1'), which version the docs rather than the API. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
